placement_predicates.ALREADY_EQUIVALENTLY_CONSUMED: existing consumer retains the same semantic distinction with the required invariances
placement_predicates.STATIC_MATERIAL_ADMISSIBLE: compile-once RuleSet/type information, no position-state availability, independent support, and no equivalent consumer
placement_predicates.DYNAMIC_EVALUATOR_ADMISSIBLE: correct consumption requires current position/state/guard availability and no equivalent consumer
placement_predicates.DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_NOT_ADMISSIBLE: frozen independence or novelty gate fails
placement_predicates.UNRESOLVED: consumer evidence is insufficient to choose safely

R1.endpoint: generic endpoint split separates Western Pawn from Western N/B/R/Q
R1.conditional: guarded reserve gives generic Western-Pawn structural distinction
R1.density: blocker profile separates Western Pawn from Western N/B/R/Q

R2.endpoint: false unless endpoint coordinates separate Knight from ray residual
R2.conditional: false unless reserve separates Knight from ray residual
R2.density: Knight blocker profile separates from Western B/R/Q rays

residual_predicates.R3: derive per family from actual Western/Shogi structures and healthy Shogi gates; never default true

redundancy_algorithm.recoverability: true only when matched controls show equal source coordinates and different target coordinates; otherwise UNRESOLVED
redundancy_algorithm.partition: compute deterministic equality classes over frozen Western plus Standard-Shogi type signatures

minimum_subset_algorithm.coverage: smallest subset whose boolean union covers R1 and R2
minimum_subset_algorithm.tie: unresolved/discrimination-insufficient unless a frozen non-numeric structural discriminator selects one

prohibited_operations: freeze observed classification as expected result
